summary: Procure SecretRotate SaaS: privileged credential rotation + 1yr seats and KMS integration
contract_term: 12 months with option to extend + annual SOW
description:
Issue summary:
Request procurement and onboarding for SecretRotate (credential rotation SaaS). Business need: centralize automated rotation of API keys, service principals, and cloud credentials across Redwood environments (hosted + dedicated), replace ad-hoc scripts and lower privileged-secret sprawl.

Scope:
- 50 named seats for privileged operators (SecOps, Platform, SRE)
- 100 ephemeral engineer seats for project-level rotations (burst pool)
- SCIM provisioning via Okta, SAML SSO, and audit-forwarding to our SIEM (Honeycomb/Datadog)
- Integration with AWS KMS for envelope encryption and HSM-backed keys (customer-managed key policy required)
- 13 month audit log retention (vendor supports 12 months by default; must confirm 13-month SLA)

Requested by: Platform Security and Infra. Cost center: INFRA-OPS-Q2. PO owner: Sophie Rodriguez (Finance contact cc'd).

Security gating / prerequisites:
- Vendor must provide SOC2 Type II report and pen-test summary (redacted ok).
- Support for customer-managed KMS key and ability to BYO-HSM for key wrapping.
- SCIM user groups mapping and role-based access (RBAC) that can be mapped to our Okta groups.
- Audit log ingestion endpoint or S3 export for compliance ingestion.

Acceptance criteria:
1) SCIM + SAML handshake tested in staging with Okta (okta-test.redwood.io) and group sync verified.
2) KMS integration tested (rotation events trigger envelope encryption using INFRA-KMS-1).
3) 10-day pilot run with SecOps and 5 eng teams showing successful rotation and no auth regressions.
4) Contract signed + PO issued, seats provisioned and billing set to INFRA-OPS-Q2.

Rollout plan (high level):
- Week 1: Legal + Security review, finalize DPA & SOC2 receipt.
- Week 2: Provision staging tenant and perform SCIM/SAML/KMS smoke.
- Week 3-4: Pilot with SecOps + two service teams (monitor rotations and token refresh behavior).
- Week 5: Expand to remaining privileged seats and enable burst pool for engineers.

Related artifacts and links are below in linked_issues / confluence fields.
acceptance_criteria: SCIM + SAML working in staging; KMS envelope encryption verified; 10-day pilot with no auth regressions; PO issued and seats provisioned
